title: EndpointDescriptor/SkillManifest live in 3 files
body: backend/src/types.ts, src/types/skill.ts, frontend/src/lib/api.ts must stay in sync; any new field (e.g. skill visibility) must land in all three or Next.js build fails TS2339 (per CLAUDE.md).

title: searchSkills swallows 401
body: frontend/src/lib/api.ts:444 searchSkills() server-side POSTs /v1/search with no Authorization header; backend 401; api.ts:450 catch{return []} -> public /search permanently empty.
